description: Review-pool feature retired. Safe-file-delete migration removes the stale `.pactile/pool/` skeleton (README / plan / items placeholder) from projects initialized before the removal. User-written pool items are never targeted.
changelog:
**@blxzer/pactile 0.5.1-beta.0**

- chore(pool): retire the review-pool feature — `pool.py`, `pool_store` / `pool_refs` / `pool_slice`, the `pool:` dependency kind, the `candidate-pool` module and Tile, and the init/update pool skeleton are all removed.
- chore(migrations): safe-file-delete removes the `.pactile/pool/` skeleton left in existing projects. Only files whose hash matches what Pactile wrote are deleted; user-authored `items/*.md` are never touched.

migrations.description: Review-pool mechanism docs retired — the pool feature was removed in 0.5.1
Review-pool plan skeleton retired — the pool feature was removed in 0.5.1
Review-pool items placeholder retired — user items are never touched

notes: Hash source: pool templates as shipped before the removal (git HEAD at removal time). computeHash normalizes CRLF to LF, so platform-variant hashes cover win32 (`python`) and linux/mac (`python3`) where `python3` appears in template content. `.pactile/pool/items/*.md` are user data and are deliberately not targeted.
